title: Café slice A: transcripts without labelling hints, and total spend in the part 2 summary
item: Fix the minor problems review tasks/reviews/049-3.md found in .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/: transcripts carry the scenario title and World line that say an unanswered booking went through, and the checker's 'means' and 'answer' fields, which can anchor the labeller; runs/part2/verdicts/summary.json reports $0.417 while part 2 spent $0.88 with the first try and off-runner calls, and STOP_AT ignores earlier spending; runs/off-runner-usage.json says three judge calls but lists four; harness/judge.py reads any reply starting 'no' (e.g. 'Not sure', 'None') as No
motivation: Review 049-3, problems 2, 3 and 5. The transcript hints can bias the labels that lines 4 and 5 of task 049 rest on; the money figure misreports cost.
notes: Builds on branch task/049-2. The transcript fix is best done before the transcripts are labelled; if done after, the labels may need redoing. Dropped 2026-11-17 on the owner's instruction: folded into task 056 (transcripts without hints for the next labelling, full spend in the summary). The slice A transcripts were labelled from their events only, before this could be done.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-17 from the minor problems in review 049-3. done_means and priority left for the owner.
